items.name: Bit Cube Open 2017

venue.name: Bannari Amman Institute of Technology
venue.address: Alathukombai Post, Erode District, Sathyamangalam, Tamil Nadu 638401

items.information: The fee for registration is to be paid at the venue. Please check the payments tab for the exact fee structure. Please bring your ID cards for identification at the college gate. New comers are advised to read the WCA regulations and the procedure for registering is as follows: 1. Create a WCA account by signing up. 2. Register for the competition under the Register tab. 3. Pay the registration fee at the venue. On spot registrations will not be entertained.

items.name: Bulldog Cubing 2017

venue.name: Harold L. Richards High School
venue.details: The competition will be held in the cafeteria

items.information: There is a registration fee of $10 There is a limit of 120 competitors This competition is open to everyone and spectators may attend for free. The competition will take place in the cafeteria. Parking will be availaible at the school. Regsitration will be done through the WCA website. Once you have submitted your registration, it will be manually approved by the orginization team. Because of this, please allow 48 hours for us to approve your registration before contacting us. *Registration on the WCA website must be manually approved. Please allow up to 48 hours after payment for us to approve your registration before contacting us. * This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the[ WCA regulations ](http://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) If you would like an in depth tutorial of what it is like when competing, please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww). Shoutout to Chris Olson for such an awesome tutorial. [CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial.](http://www.cubingusa.com/ctutorial.php) Prizes for this competition are supplied by thecubicle.us

items.name: Champagne Open 2017

venue.name: Salle des fêtes de Tinqueux
venue.address: Rue de la croix Cordier, 51430 Tinqueux

items.information: Maximum number of competitors / Nombre maximum de compétiteurs : 100. The competition is free but an attendance guarantee is asked. It will be integraly restored if : - you participate at least to one event ; - you don't want to participate and you inform us at least 48 hours before the competition. If you don't pay via internet, please ask to the organization team. / La compétition est gratuite mais une caution est demandée comme garantie de présence. Elle sera intégralement restituée dans deux cas : - si l'inscription est honorée : présence à la compétition, à au moins une épreuve ; - ou si nous sommes prévenus de l'absence au moins 48h avant le début de la compétition, pour pouvoir redistribuer la place libérée. Pour payer autrement qu'en ligne, s'adresser directement à l'équipe d'organisation. Qiyi sponsors the competition and will provide awards for the various podiums Qiyi sponsorise la compétition et va fournir des récompenses pour les différents podiums

Rubik's Cube only); * **100 RUB (~2 USD)** for equal or less than 12 events; If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please [contact us](mailto:g.sloboda@mail.ru,Lexkov27@gmail.com) to resolve the issue. Visit the competition [website](https://vk.com/kurskopen2017) for more details.
